mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.load_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS loadDate , t1.ip_user AS ipUser , fw.user_nm AS userNm , t1.load_ok AS loadOk , t1.load_naye AS loadNaye , TO_CHAR(t1.load_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS loadYmd FROM LOAD_STATUS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN FW_USER_MST fw ON fw.enc_e_mail = TO_ENCRYPTS(t1.ip_user) WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND TRUNC(t1.load_ymd) = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY t1.load_seq desc

SELECT '2' AS s1 , '현금' AS jasanNm , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) AS jmNm , t1.AEKM AS aekm , t1.CHUI_AEK AS chuiAek , t1.SIGA_AEK AS sigaAek , '0' AS loadOk FROM SHM0HM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', '') UNION ALL SELECT '3' , '주식' , t1.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM , t1.JM_CD , F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) , t1.JUSU , t1.CHUI_AEK , t1.SIGA_AEK , '0' FROM SJM0JM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', '') UNION ALL SELECT '1' , '채권' , t1.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM , t1.JM_CD , F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) , t1.AEKM , t1.CHUI_AEK , t1.SIGA_AEK , '0' FROM SCM0CM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', '') UNION ALL SELECT '4' , '펀드' , t1.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM , t1.JM_CD , F_JM_NM (t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) , t1.JWA , t1.CHUI_AEK , t1.SIGA_AEK , '0' FROM SJM5SM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', '')

SELECT t1.TR_CD AS trCd , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.TR_CO_CD AS trCoCd , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) AS jmNm , t1.OFFER_NO AS offerNo , t1.TR_JUSU AS trJusu , t1.TR_AEK AS trAek , t1.ENC_ACCT_NO AS encAcctNo , t1.KOSCOM_CD AS koscomCd , t1.DANC_GB AS dancGb , t1.SUSU AS susu , t1.TAX AS tax , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t1.SUDO_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sudoYmd , t1.STATUS AS status , '0' AS loadOk FROM SJT1JG t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', '') ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD, t1.TR_CD
